title: Ijwi ry'Ubwenge
intro: Ijwi ryoroheje ry'ubwenge ryahoze ritangwaho inama zirenze igihe. Uyu muntu, ufite ubumenyi bwimbitse, yatanze amasomo y'agaciro akomeje kuba urumuri ku bantu bose bifuza ubuyobozi. Ese ushobora guhishura umwirondoro uri inyuma y'aya magambo ahoraho?
clues: Nahawe umugisha ukomeye uturutse kuri Allah, impano yamurikiye umutima wanjye n'ubwenge bwanjye.
Nahindukiriye umwana wanjye nkunda, nifuza gusangira ubutunzi bw'agaciro kenshi nari mfite.
Naburiye ko akarengane gakomeye ari ukugirana abafatanyabikorwa n'Imana Imwe y'ukuri.
Nibukije ko n'akabuto ka sinapi gafite uburemere, gahishe mu rutare cyangwa inyuma y'ikirere, Allah azabibaza.
Nategetse kubahiriza inshingano z'ababyeyi, nubwo kumvira ari mu bijyanye no gukiranuka gusa.
Nigishije imico yoroshye: genda wicishije bugufi ku isi kandi uceceke; kuko ijwi rikaze cyane ari ugutakamba kw'indogobe.

trial.label: Urubanza / Igikorwa
options: Kubaka ubwato kugira ngo burokoke umwuzure ukomeye

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Inama ze zaratanzwe mu byanditswe byera by'Imana
Yabaye umutware ukomeye ku bwami bunini
Yahishuriwe na marayika mu buryo butaziguye
outcome.answer: Inama ze zaratanzwe mu byanditswe byera by'Imana

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
